title: Signature Duo 35 · Glamour Hourglass × Hourglass SSBBW · Jingtailan × Gamji Geumni · Marble Atrium
prompt:
Subject: TWO Black women standing side by side, clearly separated with no overlap, two hourglass figures at two very different sizes.

Skin: Both women have THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH, blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, not brown, their faces the same deep tone with natural highlights and clearly defined features, not flat.

Left woman — mid 30s, sleek high chignon with gold hairpins. Glamour hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an overwhelmingly enormous full bust, a waist cinched so impossibly tiny it is barely a third of the width of her hips, hips flaring to nearly twice the width of her shoulders, thighs thicker than her waist pressing together, soft full voluptuous curves everywhere. Not skinny, not a runway model. Body Art: Full body Chinese jingtailan cloisonne enamel painted directly on bare skin from neck to ankle. A high-gloss turquoise enamel ground divided into small cells by fine raised gold wire, filled with continuous lotus scrolls in red, cobalt, yellow, and white. The lotus scrolls spread wide across the bust and hips and narrow across the tiny waistline. No panels, no collar band. Densely filled, covering the arms and legs completely.

Right woman — early 40s, sleek low bun with a gold binyeo. Hourglass SSBBW physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits, around 500 pounds — an overwhelmingly colossal bust, enormous round hips wider than a normal woman's whole torso and flaring far beyond the shoulders, gigantic soft thighs, very thick soft arms, and a sharply cinched waist that stays clearly visible between them, with a soft rounded belly below the waistline that does not hide the waist. Huge, heavy, soft, unmistakably hourglass, not a plus-size model, not a shapeless round body. Body Art: Full body Korean gamji geumni painting painted directly on bare skin from neck to ankle. A deep indigo-blue ground like dyed indigo paper, not purple, painted in fine shimmering gold ink with continuous lotus scrolls and cloud patterns, purely ornamental, no religious figures. The gold lotus scrolls spread wide across the colossal bust and hips and narrow across the cinched waistline. Densely filled, covering the arms and legs completely.

Pose: The left woman — standing in a wide stance with a strong hip shift, one hand resting lightly on her outer thigh, the other arm hanging relaxed away from the body. The right woman — standing full frontal in a wide stance, arms relaxed slightly away from the body.

Footwear & Nails: The left woman wears extremely high turquoise enamel platform stiletto mules; the right woman wears extremely high deep indigo lacquer platform stiletto mules. Extra long nails.

Background & Lighting: A vast bright white marble atrium with a glass skylight, the background much lighter than their bodies, soft daylight from above carving the impossibly tiny waist on the left and the deep inward curve of the waist and the huge curves of the bust and hips on the right, making the materials gleam, bright highlights on every glossy curve. 3:4 vertical 8K portrait, camera at waist height, 35mm lens.
